ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's repetitions are kept: «труд трудящихся» and «праздность празднующих» (trud trudyashchikhsya, prazdnost' prazdnuyushchikh, 'the labor of those who labor', 'the idleness of those who idle'); «усовершенствования» (usovershenstvovaniya) are technical 'improvements'. In Chrysostom, «зверство» (zverstvo, 'beastliness') keeps its link to the hunted «звери» (zveri, 'wild beasts'), and «каменных людей» (kamennykh lyudey) are 'men of stone'.

Source observation: [17] The italics break inside a word: «*Дело это есть любов* ное *общение*» ('loving', любовное, split as любов + ное outside the italics); a transcription slip. The whole line is italicized in the English.
